card.name: Word-start letters after a hyphen or quote
card.fires_on: A single capital or lowercase letter that begins the next word piece, often after a hyphen, as in Immune-M(ediated) or HER2-L(ow). It also appears at the start of a split word after a quote or bracket, such as "m(ilk)" or (m(oxifloxacin)).

modes.label: Hyphenated label terms
modes.description: The first letter after a hyphen in immune-mediated or HER2-low style headings.

modes.label: Opening letter of a split word
modes.description: A lone letter starting a word that is split into pieces, in general prose or after a quote or bracket.
modes.example: He<< l>>aments that he could not publish his work

card.plain: It fires on the first letter of a word that has been split into pieces, especially after a hyphen in terms like immune-mediated.
